versions.content: Role parameter with type void * Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The type for a role parameter shall be void * if • the serverArgumentImplPolicy of the RunnableEntityArgument is set to useVoid AND • no mapping to a BswModuleEntry is defined for the related RunnableEntity .
